Vodafone Idea Rebrands, Appoints Shah Rukh Khan as Brand Ambassador

Telecom operator Vodafone Idea (Vi) has unveiled a new brand identity, including a revised logo. The company announced actor Shah Rukh Khan as its new brand ambassador. A promotional video featuring Khan was released, signaling the change with the tagline 'Ready, ho jao' (Get ready). The logo modification involves repositioning the dot from the bottom to the top.
